bio: I work in strategy consulting in London. I studied biochemistry at Imperial and management at LSE, and most of my work has been in healthcare, life sciences, and tech. Outside of work I build small web tools and AI experiments on weekends. Otherwise I'm usually bouldering, playing basketball or golf, lifting, or out for a run.
